operation_details.item: Carol is the corresponding author of Paper B.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How are the two language-model evaluation papers coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: They’re progressing well. Both Paper A and Paper B study the evaluation of language models.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. Are the authorship details settled for both papers?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. Paper A lists me as its corresponding author, and Paper B lists Carol as its corresponding author.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds clear. How is the analysis work on Paper B coming together?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Dave is contributing the error-analysis section to Paper B.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Once Dave’s section is integrated, the paper should have a stronger evaluation story.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. We’re also checking that the literature review and experimental results align with the evaluation claims.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that Carol is the corresponding author of Paper B, while retaining the authorship detail for Paper A and the other paper information.
